sections.title: SRN PLAINS/LOWER MS AND TN VALLEYS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE OZARKS WILL MOVE EWD INTO THE OH AND TN VALLEYS TODAY. A WELL-DEVELOPED LOW-LEVEL JET JUST AHEAD OF THE TROUGH WILL MOVE QUICKLY ENEWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY INTO THE APPALACHIAN MTNS. AN MCS OVER ERN AR...WRN TN AND NW MS AT THE BEGINNING OF THE PERIOD IS FORECAST TO MOVE EWD ACROSS THE TN VALLEY THIS MORNING WITH STORMS EXPANDING IN COVERAGE AS SFC TEMPS WARM UP. THE SEVERE THREAT WITH THE MCS MAY INCREASE BY LATE MORNING INTO THE EARLY AFTERNOON AS INSTABILITY INCREASES AND LOW-LEVEL FLOW STRENGTHENS. AN ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY EXIST ACROSS THE TN VALLEY WHERE THE NAMKF SHOWS A LARGE-SCALE BOWING LINE-SEGMENT AROUND MIDDAY MOVING THROUGH MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH ABOUT 40 KT OF VERTICAL SHEAR. FURTHER NORTH INTO SRN KY...CONVECTION MAY BE MORE DISCRETE AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO AND HAIL THREAT COULD EXIST AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET MOVES ACROSS THE AREA AROUND MID-AFTERNOON. MODEL FORECASTS ARE RELATIVELY CONSISTENT DEVELOPING A LARGE MCS FROM NRN MS AND NRN AL MOVING THIS CONVECTIVE SYSTEM SEWD THIS AFTERNOON. A FEW TORNADOES AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE LIKELY WITH THE MORE PERSISTENT STORM CLUSTERS EMBEDDED IN THE MCS. FURTHER WEST ACROSS THE ARKLATEX.

sections.title: CAROLINAS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE EWD INTO THE MS VALLEY TODAY AS A STRONG LOW-LEVEL JET INCREASES LOW-LEVEL FLOW ACROSS THE ERN SEABOARD. AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY SHOULD AGAIN BE IN PLACE THIS AFTERNOON AS STORMS DEVELOP IN THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WRN SC AND CNTRL NC MOVING ENEWD INTO THE LOWER ELEVATIONS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS THE SLIGHT RISK AREA EARLY THIS AFTERNOON SHOW MODERATE VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES WITH ABOUT 30 KT OF FLOW JUST ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER. THIS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR WIND DAMAGE WITH THE MORE PERSISTENT CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS. IF A FEW SUPERCELLS CAN DEVELOP AND MOVE NEWD ALONG AN OLD FRONTAL BOUNDARY...THEN AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE NRN PLAINS WILL MOVE EWD INTO THE UPPER MIDWEST TODAY. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD DEVELOP AHEAD OF THE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH ON THE NRN END OF A BROAD AREAS OF INSTABILITY. ALTHOUGH VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES WILL BE ON THE WEAK SIDE...MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE QUITE STEEP WHICH COMBINED WITH COLD AIR ALOFT SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THREAT THIS AFTERNOON. ..BROYLES/HURLBUT.. 05/06/2009

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: VERY COMPLEX FORECAST THIS MORNING WITH SERIES OF MORNING SEVERE MCSS ALONG AND NEAR EFFECTIVE WARM FRONT ARCING FROM THE SRN APPALACHIANS INTO NERN TX AT DAYBREAK. THIS IS OCCURRING AHEAD OF BROAD MID/UPPER LEVEL TROUGH WHICH IS FORECAST TO EJECT NEWD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES/OH RIVER VALLEY AND CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES TODAY. SYNOPTIC SURFACE LOW IS FORECAST TO DEEPEN OUT OF THE TN VALLEY AND INTO THE UPPER OH RIVER VALLEYS TODAY...AS 60+ KT SWLY LLJ EJECTS FROM THE TN VALLEY ACROSS THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS/VA INTO THE EVENING. IN ADDITION...FAST MOVING NRN STREAM IMPULSE NOW MOVING OVER THE NRN PLAINS MAY FOCUS ADDITIONAL AREA OF STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT INTO THE UPPER MS RIVER VALLEY REGION LATER TODAY.

sections.title: RED RIVER VALLEY OF OK/TX INTO THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM FORECAST FOR REMAINDER OF DAY WILL BE STRONGLY INFLUENCE BY ONGOING MORNING MCS ACTIVITY. SMALL BOWING MCS OVER NERN TX IS ALREADY BEING FED BY A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS SOUTH OF MAIN SURFACE WARM FRONT...WITH SUFFICIENT INFLOW/INSTABILITY FOR CONTINUED THREAT OF WIND DAMAGE INTO ERN TX/WRN-CENTRAL LA THROUGH THE EARLY AFTERNOON. ADDITIONAL LINEAR MCS OVER MS/AL IS BEGINNING TO ORIENT ITSELF A BIT MORE NORMAL TO MODERATE WSWLY FLOW ALOFT OVER E-CENTRAL MS. THIS ACTIVITY IS ALSO BEING FED BY VERY MOIST/UNSTABLE AIR WITHIN WARM SECTOR AND SHOULD SUPPORT THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS ACROSS CENTRAL AL INTO PORTIONS OF WRN/NRN GA THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. ISOLATED TORNADOES MAY ACCOMPANY ANY LEADING SUPERCELLS/OR FROM CIRCULATIONS ALONG LEADING EDGE OF THE LINE WITH BOTH MCSS. LARGE HAIL THREAT CAN ALSO BE EXPECTED WITH ELEVATED STORMS TRAILING SYSTEMS AND NORTH OF CONVECTIVELY-STABILIZED AIR.

sections.title: SRN APPALACHIANS/GA INTO THE CAROLINAS
sections.text: ANOTHER MESSY CONVECTIVE DAY LIKELY ACROSS THIS REGION WITH ONGOING MCS ACROSS NRN GA POSSIBLY INCREASING ACROSS UPSTATE SC AS AIRMASS BECOMES MARGINALLY UNSTABLE AND WEAKLY CAPPED AHEAD OF IT. ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY DEVELOP INVOF STATIONARY SURFACE TROUGH AND/OR SEA BREEZE OVER THE CAROLINAS AS AFTERNOON HEATING OVERCOMES WEAK CAP. DEEP LAYER SHEAR SHOULD INCREASE THROUGH THE DAY AS MID/UPPER TROUGH APPROACHES...SUGGESTING STORM-SCALE ORGANIZATION INTO BOWS/SUPERCELLS WITH MYRIAD OF SEVERE THREATS EVOLVING WITH ANY PERSISTENT CLUSTER. ADDITIONAL SEVERE THREAT MAY EVOLVE LATER TODAY/THIS EVENING WITH ANY MCS DEVELOPMENT SHIFTING NEWD AWAY FROM THE SRN APPALACHIANS/CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES.

sections.title: TN VALLEY INTO PORTIONS OF WV/VA AND THE UPPER OH ALLEY
sections.text: HAVE EXTENDED SLGT RISK AND RELEVANT PROBABILITIES NEWD INTO THIS REGION GIVEN THE EXTREME LOW LEVEL SHEAR AND POSSIBILITY OF SURFACE-BASED THUNDERSTORMS WITHIN LOW-CAPE ENVIRONMENT LATER TODAY/EVENING INVOF SURFACE LOW AND LLJ MENTIONED ABOVE. THREAT IS CONDITIONAL ON DEVELOPMENT OF SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY AND QUESTIONS OF OVERALL IMPACT FROM LARGE MCSS TO THE SW THIS MORNING. INSTABILITY MAY BE A BIT GREATER EAST OF THE APPALACHIANS INTO VA AS INFLUX OF RICHER LOW LEVEL MOISTURE NOW OVER NC ADVECTS NWD THROUGH THE DAY. HOWEVER...LAPSE RATES ARE FORECAST TO REMAIN QUITE WEAK THROUGH THE PERIOD. ALTHOUGH...SHOULD EVEN MODEST SBCAPE EVOLVE LATER TODAY...FORECAST SOUNDINGS INDICATE VERY LARGE/LOOPING LOW LEVEL HODOGRAPHS SUPPORTIVE OF AT LEAST AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT. NWD EXTENT OF SEVERE THREAT MAY BE LIMITED INTO THE MID ATLANTIC/PA...ALTHOUGH INFLUX OF MODEST SURFACE THETA-E AND LARGE LOW LEVEL SHEAR WARRANTS AT LEAST LOW SEVERE PROBABILITIES NWD INTO THIS REGION.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF CENTRAL PLAINS INTO THE UPPER MS RIVER VALLEY
sections.text: FORECAST SOUNDINGS INDICATE AIR MASS WILL DESTABILIZE SUFFICIENTLY FOR 500-1000 J/KG MLCAPE AHEAD OF APPROACHING MID LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED SURFACE FRONT OVER THIS REGION. ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD EVOLVE DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON ONCE AGAIN AND CONTINUE EWD INTO THE EARLY EVENING. ADDITIONAL CLUSTER OF ELEVATED STORMS MAY ACCOMPANY LATE NIGHT IMPULSE SHIFTING SEWD ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS EARLY THURSDAY MORNING...WITH HAIL POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER CORES. ..EVANS/GARNER.. 05/06/2009

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: TROUGH LOWER MS VALLEY SHIFTS TO MID ATLANTIC STATES BY THU AM AS UNSEASONABLY STRONG POLAR JET EXTENDS FROM PAC NW TO NRN PLAINS. ACTIVE MCS/S ONGOING AHEAD OF TROUGH FEEDING OFF OF A MOIST...MODERATELY UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR ACROSS GULF COAST STATES. AS TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED STRONGER WIND FIELD SHIFT EWD ACROSS GULF STATES INTO MID ATLANTIC REGION...THE MCS/S SEVERE THREAT WILL SPREAD FROM CURRENT LOCATION MS/AL ACROSS GA INTO THE CAROLINAS BY THIS EVENING. NRN STREAM S/WV TROUGH ACCOMPANIED BY STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL BRING A THREAT OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS PORTIONS OF UPPER MS VALLEY BY AFTERNOON AS AIRMASS DESTABILIZES.

sections.title: CENTRAL GULF STATES
sections.text: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM FORECAST FOR REMAINDER OF DAY WILL BE STRONGLY INFLUENCED BY ONGOING MCS ACTIVITY. LINEAR MCS OVER AL WITH EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE EWD WITH PRIMARILY A WIND DAMAGE THREAT...HOWEVER AS THE WARM SECTOR CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE DISCRETE SUPERCELL STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE DURING AFTERNOON INCREASING THE THREAT OF TORNADOS. GIVEN THE 50-60 KT OF SHEAR/MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES IN EXCESS OF 7C/KM AND MLCAPES TO 2000 J/KG...THE LINE OF STORMS SHOULD MAINTAIN SEVERE CHARACTERISTICS ACROSS GA INTO SC DURING AFTERNOON. UPSTREAM MCS MOVING FROM SRN AR/NRN LA INTO MS WILL ALSO MAINTAIN RISK OF BOTH LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE AS THE WARM SECTOR ACROSS MS AND BACK INTO AL BECOMES VERY UNSTABLE THIS AFTERNOON AS MLCAPES RISE TO AOA 3000 J/KG. WHILE UPPER TROUGH WILL BE PULLING AWAY FROM THIS AREA...THE LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE COUPLED WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES AND INSTABILITY STILL FAVORS SUPERCELL POTENTIAL ALONG WITH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES. FURTHER W RISING HEIGHTS AND WARMING ALOFT SHOULD GRADUALLY CAP OFF MUCH OF ERN TX WITH JUST RISK OF ISOLATED STORMS. HOWEVER WITH THE UNSTABLE AIRMASS ANY STORM COULD QUICKLY BECOME SEVERE WITH A LARGE HAIL THREAT.

sections.title: CENTRAL GULF STATES INTO THE CAROLINAS
sections.text: TWO SEPARATE LINES OF CONVECTION ARE IN THE PROCESS OF MERGING INTO ONE LARGE/ARCING LINE -- EXTENDING FROM NRN GA WSWWD INTO CENTRAL AND SRN AL/SRN MS. AHEAD OF THE CONVECTION...A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER COMBINED WITH DAYTIME HEATING HAS YIELDED A MODERATELY-UNSTABLE AIRMASS /1000 TO 1500 J/KG MIXED-LAYER CAPE/. WITH MODERATE BUT SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER WIND FIELD SUPPORTING A CONTINUED THREAT FOR ORGANIZED STORMS...SEVERE POTENTIAL CONTINUES ACROSS THIS REGION. FARTHER E/NE INTO SERN GA/THE CAROLINAS/SRN VA...STORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP WITHIN MOIST/MODERATELY-UNSTABLE AIRMASS WHICH CONTINUES SPREADING SLOWLY NWD INTO VA. WITH MODERATELY-STRONG WIND FIELD SUPPORTING ORGANIZED STORMS...THREAT FOR HAIL AND/OR LOCALLY-DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES. AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO WILL ALSO REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS THE ENTIRE SLIGHT RISK AREA...WITH A SLIGHTLY-ENHANCED THREAT PERHAPS EVOLVING WITH TIME ACROSS VA WHERE BACKED/SELY BOUNDARY-LAYER FLOW IS YIELDING MORE FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR.

sections.title: TN VALLEY INTO PORTIONS OF WV/VA
sections.text: VERY LIMITED INSTABILITY /LESS THAN 500 J/KG MIXED-LAYER CAPE/ HAS HINDERED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT -- AND THUS SEVERE POTENTIAL -- ACROSS THIS REGION DESPITE FAVORABLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR. WILL MAINTAIN SLIGHT RISK FORECAST ACROSS ERN TN/ERN KY AND SRN WV...BUT ATTM IT APPEARS THAT GREATER SEVERE POTENTIAL WILL REMAIN E OF THE APPALACHIANS THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE PERIOD.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: WIDESPREAD SHOWER AND THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS ONGOING ACROSS THIS REGION...WHERE 500 TO 1000 J/KG MIXED-LAYER CAPE HAS DEVELOPED THIS AFTERNOON AHEAD OF A SURFACE COLD FRONT NOW EXTENDING FROM N CENTRAL MN SSWWD INTO ERN NEB/CENTRAL KS. WHILE PRESENCE OF AN MCV AND ASSOCIATED CLOUD COVER OVER SRN AND ERN IA/SERN MN HAS LIMITED DESTABILIZATION LOCALLY...AND THOUGH SHEAR REMAINS MARGINAL FOR WELL-ORGANIZED STORMS...SOME THREAT FOR HAIL AND/OR LOCALLY-DAMAGING WINDS PERSISTS. THE GREATEST THREAT APPEARS TO EXIST NEAR THE FRONT INVOF THE MID MO VALLEY AND INTO PARTS OF SRN MN...AND THUS WILL MAINTAIN A SLIGHT RISK FOR HAIL ACROSS THIS PORTION OF THE AREA. ELSEWHERE...MORE LIMITED SEVERE POTENTIAL WILL PERSIST THROUGH EARLY EVENING. ..GOSS.. 05/06/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1125 AM CDT WED MAY 06 2009/
